body.title: chore(deps): bump the pip group across 1 directory with 2 updates
body.body:
Bumps the pip group with 2 updates in the /nexum_ai directory: [filelock](https://github.com/tox-dev/py-filelock) and [pillow](https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow). Updates `filelock` from 3.20.0 to 3.20.3
Release notes

Sourced from filelock's releases.

3.20.3

What's Changed

  • Fix TOCTOU symlink vulnerability in SoftFileLock by @​gaborbernat in tox-dev/filelock#465
